note: Pan-India schemes. Only PMMVY has a deep eligibility flow in the MVP; the rest are discovery cards with a human handoff.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000 for the first child in 2 instalments; ₹6,000 if the second child is a girl

verification.note: Amounts confirmed by several secondary sources. Official portal could not be reached. Disadvantaged-group criterion, age 19 and 270-day apply window need official confirmation.

schemes.name: Lakhpati Didi / DAY-NRLM
schemes.benefit: Self-Help Group membership, collateral-free credit and skill training, aiming at ₹1,00,000+ annual household income

verification.note: A livelihood programme and target, not a fixed cash payout. Never describe it as a payment.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.benefit: Government savings account for a girl child with a high interest rate and tax benefit

verification.note: Interest rate is revised every quarter. Do NOT hard-code ~8.2%; say 'check the current rate at the post office or bank'. Opening age limit for the girl and 80C only under the old tax regime must be confirmed.

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection and cylinder refill subsidy

verification.note: Household eligibility conditions and current subsidy per cylinder must be confirmed. Do not state a subsidy amount until verified.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.benefit: Bank loans from ₹10 lakh up to ₹1 crore for new (greenfield) women-led businesses

verification.note: Confirm the scheme is still accepting applications and that the loan range is unchanged.
